meta.label: Season 3
meta.source: PBE datamine via CommunityDragon (PBE vs live client data); the locally installed PBE client is on the same build
meta.caveat: PBE content can change before release.
notes: The 40th new augment is the generic Pentakill augment (GoH_PentakillAug_Generic). It has no name in the data; its tooltip says it Empowers one basic ability, and a second ability (ultimate included) at level 18.
Some tooltips use placeholders the data does not fill in (for example exact Attack Speed amounts), so some descriptions leave out numbers.
aram.bin changes are keybind config only, not per-champion ARAM balance. Per-champion ARAM damage/healing modifiers were not found in the data.
Champion arrays are listed for ranks 1-5 (basic abilities) or 1-3 (ultimates). Mode-specific values for Arena, URF and other modes are excluded.
Build 16.21.8284168 (2026-10-16) reverted the Caitlyn passive crit nerf, extended the Qiyana Q nerf to unenchanted Q, and made Fruitify step up at levels 7, 11 and 15 instead of scaling smoothly.

fame.summary: Earn Fame to unlock bands in order. Each band has its own in-game objectives, member dialogue and six rewards. The final reward is "Welcome to the band!".
fame.relatedCosmetics: True Damage "Know My Name" skins and per-band Prospect/Member icons look like rewards for this track (inferred, not confirmed).

superstarRank.summary: Fame also raises your Superstar Rank (10 milestones on its own track) and unlocks bands plus Audition Missions, which must be completed within a single game.

headliners.summary: New per-match "Headliner" system (internally Guest of Honor). Each Mayhem match features one Headliner that adds game-wide bonuses and effects. Replaces the old "Quest Augments" menu section.

list.name: Pentakill
list.effect: Grants the Pentakill augments, which Empower an ability (+20 Ability Haste, +10% damage, healing and shielding).

list.name: HEARTSTEEL
list.effect: Members put Stickers on some augment offers. Picking a stickered augment grants a member-specific bonus.

list.name: K/DA
list.effect: K/DA throws Photocards during the match. Collecting the full set grants an extra augment.

list.name: Bees
list.effect: Honey and Bees fly across the map. Honey gives your team 25 gold and heals you for 20% max Health. A Bee hit deals 15% max Health true damage.

list.name: Disco
list.effect: Dance on the Dance Floor until the Disco Ball drops, which grants everyone 1,000 gold.

list.name: Command Line
list.effect: "Hacked Rerolls" improve your augments. Voice lines also mention hacked merch stalls.
list.note: Exact effect not spelled out in the strings.

list.name: Cafe Cuties
list.effect: Hands out treats that grant decaying bonus Move Speed. Health Relics are empowered: +20% missing Health restored and 25% decaying Move Speed for 6s.
list.note: The Health Relic link to Cafe Cuties is inferred from the strings.

list.name: True Damage
list.note: Listed as a Headliner, but its in-game effect wasn't found in the strings.

championChanges.summary: Base champion changes on PBE. They apply in Mayhem unless a Mayhem override replaces the value (none of these are overridden except Varus Q and Lee Sin W above).

changes: Passive headshot bonus at level breakpoints +20% → +10%
W additional heal starts at 20 instead of 40
Q base damage 80/110/140/170/200 → 70/100/130/160/190, now for both enchanted and unenchanted Q
Q reworked: 50/95/140/185/230 + 80% bonus AD, up to +70% with charge (was 80/150/220/290/360 + 120% bonus AD at max charge)
W cooldown refund per Blight stack 13% → 11%
E permanent Attack Speed conversion value 5 → 4

itemChanges.summary: Changes to items in the Mayhem shop. Runes and summoner mutators are unchanged.

changes: Values restructured into melee vs ranged multipliers. Resulting numbers look the same: 15 AD base and 2 AD per statue melee, about 10 and 1 ranged.
Removed from the consumables quick-buy and from the item data, along with the Healthbar Splash cosmetics

outsideMayhemShop: Bastionbreaker: Lethality 22 → 18, Shaped Charge damage 50 → 40 (not in the Mayhem item list)

modeChanges: Health Relics are added to the Mayhem map's character list (they tie in with the Cafe Cuties Headliner).
New champion augment tags: each champion gets excluded and build tags, and a new AugmentFilters data set is loaded for Mayhem. Augment offers likely get tailored to the champion's kit.
Mayhem gets its own audio feature on the Bloom map skin (BloomKiwi).
Bot difficulty constants changed (AI level-up health penalty 0.7 → 0.99, max HP penalty 0.65 → 0.99). This only matters in games with bots.
Menu copy: the mode is pitched as "THIS IS MAYHEM" and "JOURNEY TO STARDOM"; the old "Quest Augments" section is now "HEADLINERS".
